description: Línea de Costa del Reino de España (INSPIRE) is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Catálogo Oficial de Datos y Servicios INSPIRE. Coast line extracted from the electronic nautical charts (ENC) of purpose 4 and 5 of navigation published by the Hydrographic Institute of the Navy (IHM) of Spain. The resolution base is considered a scale of 1:50000 although there are areas where the resolution can reach 1:22000. Coverage: Spain. The portal shows the English title as "Coastline of the Kingdom of Spain (INSPIRE)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Catálogo Oficial de Datos y Servicios INSPIRE. Its keywords include Hydrography, Hidrografía, IHM, High Tide, Pleamar, High-value dataset. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
